Title: Jyhad: Social Charm and Praxis Seizures

Messages.Author: S. Dembo
Messages.Body:
Two questions, one of which I probably already know the answer to.
1) Just to double check, since Social Charm is a bleed as a directed 
action, you CAN bleed your predator with it, right?

2) Ok, here's teh weird question...  Let's say I have Sir Walter Nash 
out.  Can I cast a Ventrue Justicar political aciton, make him the 
Justicar and get 5 votes from him?  WE've had this happen several time 
before...  the way WE decided it was if you make a Primogen a Prince with 
a Praxis Seizure, they only get 2 votes, as by definition, Primogen's 
support the Prince.  If a Prince through Praxis Seizure become the Prince 
of more than one City, they still only get 2 votes, as they can only be 
in one city at a time in order to cast tehir votes.  However, if a Prince 
becuase a Justicar through a political aciton, I see no reason why they 
couldnt' get 5 votes since being Justicar ONLY deals with clan activites 
where Princes deal with their Cities activites, so someone who is Both 
prince AND Justicar would get 2 votes for controlling the city and 3 
votes fro controlling the clan...  
what do ya'all think?  Tom?  ANy official words?

steve

In article <Pine.3.89.9409051621.A12397-0100000@blue.weeg.uiowa.edu>,
sdembo@blue.weeg.uiowa.edu (S. Dembo) wrote:
>Two questions, one of which I probably already know the answer to.
>1) Just to double check, since Social Charm is a bleed as a directed 
>action, you CAN bleed your predator with it, right?

I would say yes, that's how we're playing it now.  A (D) action can be 
directed against anyone unless specifically narrowed down.

>2) Ok, here's teh weird question...  Let's say I have Sir Walter Nash 
>out.  Can I cast a Ventrue Justicar political aciton, make him the 
>Justicar and get 5 votes from him?  WE've had this happen several time 
>before...  the way WE decided it was if you make a Primogen a Prince with 
>a Praxis Seizure, they only get 2 votes, as by definition, Primogen's 
>support the Prince.  If a Prince through Praxis Seizure become the Prince 
>of more than one City, they still only get 2 votes, as they can only be 
>in one city at a time in order to cast tehir votes.  However, if a Prince 
>becuase a Justicar through a political aciton, I see no reason why they 
>couldnt' get 5 votes since being Justicar ONLY deals with clan activites 
>where Princes deal with their Cities activites, so someone who is Both 
>prince AND Justicar would get 2 votes for controlling the city and 3 
>votes fro controlling the clan...  
>what do ya'all think?  Tom?  ANy official words?

I'm so glad someone else has had this happen.  We've had the same happen with
Praxis Seizures in recent games.  We generally ruled (until we hear 
differently from WotC) that you can only use one title at a time.  If you 
give Justicar to a Prince, you can either use the Prince votes, or Justicar
votes at one time.....and likewise with Primogens.  I dislike the idea that
gaining a higher title strips away the lower title, as was bandied about
during a game....it makes Seizures a little less powerful in contention.

Tom, HELP! :)

--Red
